meaning:
ἁλίζω
(ἅλς), [in LXX for מָלַח ;]
to salt, season with salt: Mat.5:13, Mrk.9:49.†
(AS)
glosses: can it be made salty again

renderings.bsb: can it be made salty again

elsewhere.note: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden…
For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.
